changes: Added m2-provider-execution-authorization.json, extended the provider execution checker, updated status/README text, and clarified the M2 provider execution plan so B-11be is metadata-only with USD 0.00 provider spend.
usage: Run node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m2-provider-execution-check.mjs to verify the authorization metadata boundary and sequencing status before any future provider-execution story.
expectedOutcome: Terminal output should show M2-provider authorization metadata: Done, Provider spend in B-11be: USD 0.00, Provider cells run in B-11be: none, nextPermittedFormalStep=cell-03-calibration, cell-06-a2prime-blocked, and no provider calls made.
actualTranscript: The checker printed 493 assertions and 36 negative controls rejected, M2-provider authorization metadata: Done, Provider spend in B-11be: USD 0.00, Provider cells run in B-11be: none, nextPermittedFormalStep=cell-03-calibration, cell-06-a2prime-blocked, Cell 06 A2prime: blocked, and Provider execution remains disabled; no provider calls made; no outcome records present. lattice validate passed 34/34 commands with 9/9 verification intents covered; done_required_validate passed build and root full suite.
outcomeDiff: No difference: actual output matched the expected metadata-only authorization boundary and preserved all non-execution constraints.
limitations: B-11be does not run provider cells, does not produce result rows, does not unlock H-M1/H-M3/model-agnostic claims, and does not authorize cell 06; real provider execution still requires a separate story with dated snapshots and nonzero budget.
pitfalls: Scope contract initialization was needed after DEV because the story used explicit file scopes; ProofStory metadata and a decision-doc stale-status correction required reviewer-visible scope acknowledgements. Validate took about 260 seconds per run, and done-required validation took about 115 seconds.
